observations.body: Dashboard welcomes Emily and shows leave balance 18 days, pending leave requests 0, and quick actions for Request leave and Fill timesheet. Navigation links lead to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet and My Profile; Notifications shows a count of 3 and Log out is offered.
The Dashboard is loaded and the Directory link is visible in the primary navigation.
Selecting Directory opened /directory. The settled page showed the Employee directory with a search field, department selector, 28 employees, and page 1 of 3.
The Directory navigation link reached the Employee directory surface at /directory.

Employee directory shows a name search field, department selector with All departments plus Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance and HR, and a table with Name, Department, Title and Email columns. Name displays an upward sort marker. It reports 28 employees on page 1 of 3; Previous is disabled and Next is enabled.
The settled directory is on page 1 of 3 with Next enabled.
Selecting Next advanced the directory from page 1 to page 2 of 3. The settled page showed ten employees from Julia Romero through Samuel Turner; the count remained 28 employees.
The directory search field is empty and accepts text while page 2 of 3 is displayed.
The text locator timed out before filling; a fresh snapshot shows the search field remains empty and the directory remains on page 2 of 3.

look.reason: The supplied accessible-name selector could not locate the textbox; snapshot confirms no text was entered.

observations.body: The directory remains on page 2 with its search field empty.

repeat.reason: The prior attempt failed to locate the textbox and a fresh snapshot confirmed no text was entered.

observations.body: Filling the search field with Emily Dawson reduced the results from 28 employees on page 2 to one employee, Emily Dawson (Engineering, Software Engineer), on page 1 of 1.

My leave shows an available balance of 18 days and states that days are deducted when a request is approved. Request history contains one visible approved Vacation request for Aug 11 to 12, 2026, with 3 days and manager comment Approved - enjoy!. A New request link is available.
The My leave page is loaded and the New request link is visible.

Selecting New request opened /leave/new with a leave type selector defaulted to Vacation, required Start date and End date fields, a Reason field, Submit request and Cancel buttons. The page notes that weekends are not counted toward leave.
New request reached the New leave request surface at /leave/new.

The New leave request form offers Vacation (selected), Sick and Personal leave types; required Start date and End date text fields; an optional Reason text area; Submit request and Cancel buttons. The date fields are read-only in the current capture, while the Reason field is editable. The page notes weekends are not counted.
The Start date field is read-only and its available interaction can be checked by opening its date picker.
The New leave request form is open with an empty, read-only Start date field.
Clicking the read-only Start date field opened a calendar for September 2026 with previous and next month arrows and weekday headings Monday through Sunday.

My profile displays editable Full name, Phone and Emergency contact fields, a disabled read-only email field, an Upload photo control and Save changes button. Current values are Emily Dawson, 555-0107, emily.dawson@bugbusters.io and Robert Dawson, 555-0207 respectively.
Timesheet is a draft for the week of Sep 7, 2026. It has editable hour inputs for Monday through Sunday, all currently 0, a Total: 0 h summary, and Save draft and Submit week buttons.
The Timesheet for Sep 7, 2026 is in draft state with all seven daily hour fields at 0 and a total of 0 h.
Selecting Save draft kept the week of Sep 7, 2026 in draft state, retained 0 hours for each day and displayed Draft saved.
